rohit: Heads-up: PR ready for security review — HSM integration + KMS policy change to add audit_key rotation hook. Need security + compliance eyes before merge. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4821

rohit: Quick diff snippet:
```diff
-    "Action": "kms:*",
+    "Action": ["kms:GenerateDataKey", "kms:Decrypt"],
     "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/*"
```

camille: Taking a look now. @sara can you double-check compliance tags?

sara: On it. Quick Q: does this change key ARN scope for customers? If yes, we need to note it in SOC2 doc.

trent: Left a small comment on the permissions scope — prefer least-priv. Also please add a unit test for the rotation handler.

rohit: Thanks @trent — added test in last push, see commit 9f3b2d. CI shows one flaky smoke test failing.

sec-bot: Automated scan: no high/critical findings. Minor IAM warning: policy includes broad kms:Encrypt on audit role.

camille: Please fix that IAM warning before merge. @rohit can you narrow the policy to only the needed actions (GenerateDataKey, Decrypt) and limit the Resource to the audit key ARN?

rohit: Yep, will update in ~30m and push another commit. Requesting 1 more approval after change. Target to merge by EOD if green. :+1:

sara: Compliance: OK as long as rotation events are emitted to the audit log (we check they hit CloudTrail and our internal audit pipeline).

camille: Approving conditionally — will give final approve after the IAM tweak and green CI.

trent: Approved after tests pass and IAM tightened. Please squash when merging.

rohit: Will merge after green CI. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
